title.text: EGFR resistance — does MM-GBSA rank better than docking?
title.raw: # EGFR resistance — does MM-GBSA rank better than docking?

results.text: Both methods put T790M first. MM-GBSA resolves T790M from the triple-mutant construct: −15.0 kcal/mol (95 % CI −23.8 … −6.3; Welch p = 0.01; n = 3 seeds per genotype). About two thirds of that gap (−10.1) is van der Waals.
results.raw:
* **Both methods put T790M first.** MM-GBSA resolves T790M from the triple-mutant construct: −15.0 kcal/mol
  (95 % CI −23.8 … −6.3; Welch p = 0.01; n = 3 seeds per genotype). About two thirds of that gap (−10.1) is van der Waals.
results.heading: Result in brief

limitations.text: 1. Starting-structure bias. WT starts from a gefitinib-bound crystal, T790M and the triple construct from structures with the co-crystal ligand YY3; osimertinib was docked into all three. Pocket shape differs by construction, which can favour the mutants and contributes to the WT pose drift. 2. n = 3 seeds from one equilibrated state per genotype: SDs underestimate structural uncertainty; the T790M–WT comparison is under-powered. 3. WT not converged at 20 ns (seed 3 drifting, seed 1 settled in a displaced pose). A longer WT run from several starting poses is the remaining open item. 4. Osimertinib binds C797 covalently; everything here is non-covalent, so C797S resistance is not expected to appear in these energies. 5. No entropy; GB/PB disagree by ≈ 60 kcal/mol in absolute terms; only rankings are used. 6. Per-residue decomposition uses 25 frames per run and three seeds; an earlier single-seed version (one seed vs an unequilibrated WT) suggested residue 797 as the largest contributor (−3.4); with three seeds it is −1.66 ± 0.85 and not resolved, and residue 718 leads.
limitations.raw:
1. **Starting-structure bias.** WT starts from a gefitinib-bound crystal, T790M and the triple construct from structures with the co-crystal ligand YY3; osimertinib was docked into all three. Pocket shape differs by construction, which can favour the mutants and contributes to the WT pose drift.
2. **n = 3 seeds from one equilibrated state** per genotype: SDs underestimate structural uncertainty; the T790M–WT comparison is under-powered.
3. **WT not converged** at 20 ns (seed 3 drifting, seed 1 settled in a displaced pose). A longer WT run from several starting poses is the remaining open item.
4. Osimertinib binds C797 covalently; everything here is non-covalent, so C797S resistance is not expected to appear in these energies.
5. No entropy; GB/PB disagree by ≈ 60 kcal/mol in absolute terms; only rankings are used.
6. Per-residue decomposition uses 25 frames per run and three seeds; an earlier single-seed version (one seed vs an unequilibrated WT) suggested residue 797 as the largest contributor (−3.4); with three seeds it is −1.66 ± 0.85 and not resolved, and residue 718 leads.

limitations.text: This is descriptive reporting with arbitrary units. It performs no curve fitting, hypothesis testing, confidence interval calculation, or potency estimation.
